observations: The illustration features a child named Maya in an open garden. She has long dark curls, medium brown skin, a round face, warm brown eyes, and soft eyebrows. Maya is wearing a yellow cardigan over a white shirt, a blue skirt, white socks, and navy shoes. She is depicted opening and closing her empty hands while looking at a star that is blinking above her yellow sleeves. The setting includes a small grassy clearing with a tall pale wall and unobstructed view of the sky, where distant stars can be seen.
